title: Direction-Dependent Rotation Error and Calibration Trade-offs in Sparse-IMU Gait Estimation
description: Version 1.1.1 reproducibility record for sparse-IMU gait estimation under imposed sensor-frame rotations. Includes the frozen virtual-IMU derived dataset (747 gait cycles, 138 participants), participant-disjoint Ridge analysis source and original reproduction outputs, summary tables from external Camargo physical-IMU analysis (248 windows, 19 participants), and numerical findings on rotation-axis sensitivity, physical-specific regularization, and recalibration. Late-stage execution archives containing code and detailed intermediate results must be committed to r2_reanalysis/artifacts before the v1.1.1 GitHub release is published. Raw Camargo HDF5 and original C3D data are not redistributed. The results address imposed coordinate-frame rotations, not validated physical IMU remounting.

creators.name: Lima Júnior, Sérgio de Nazaré Rodrigues
